product_id.description: bol.com product id, the number at the end of a product URL (1004004012362052). Pattern: ^[0-9]{10,20}$.

url.description: HTTPS bol.com product URL (/nl/nl/p/{slug}/{id}/). Supply this or product_id. Pattern: ^https://(?:www\.)?bol\.com/(?:nl|be)/(?:nl|fr)/p/[^/?#]+/[0-9]{10,20}/?(?:[?#].*)?$.

200.description:
Get public bol.com product details by product id or URL: title, brand, EAN, buy-box EUR price and reference price, seller, delivery promise and shipping cost, availability, rating and review count, category path, specifications and images.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `availability` | string | schema.org availability from the page's structured data, for example 'InStock' or 'OutOfStock'. |
| `availability_text` | string | Stock and delivery text as displayed, for example 'Op voorraad. Voor 23:59 uur besteld, maandag in huis'. |
| `available` | boolean | bol.com shows a buy-box offer. false when the product has no offer (not deliverable); price, seller and delivery fields are then null. |
| `brand` | string |  |
| `category_path` | string[] | Primary category from the top level down, for example ['Speelgoed', 'Spellen', 'Bordspellen']. |
| `country` | string |  |
| `currency` | string |  |
| `delivery_date` | string | Latest promised delivery date for the session's default (Dutch) address. |
| `ean` | string | EAN/GTIN from the specifications, or the page's structured data. |
| `id` | string |  |
| `images` | string[] | Product image URLs in gallery order, largest rendition. |
| `list_price` | number | Reference price bol.com shows next to the offer (usually the brand's 'Adviesprijs'), in EUR; null when none is shown. |
| `list_price_label` | string | Label of list_price as displayed, for example 'Adviesprijs'; null when list_price is null. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `price` | number | Buy-box selling price in EUR (34.99). null only when available is false. |
| `rating` | number | Average review rating out of 5; null without reviews. |
| `review_count` | number |  |
| `seller` | string | Seller of the buy-box offer: 'bol' for bol.com's own stock, otherwise the partner shop name. |
| `seller_id` | string | bol.com retailer id of the seller. |
| `seller_rating` | number | Seller rating out of 10 as shown for partner shops; null for bol.com itself or when not shown. |
| `shipping_cost` | number | Shipping cost of the buy-box offer in EUR (0 for free shipping); null when not shown. |
| `specifications` | object[] | Specification rows as displayed (Dutch labels); multi-valued rows are joined with ', '. |
| `title` | string |  |
| `url` | string |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
